readings.Aries: You have more capacity for tenderness than you show. Today someone needs to see it. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Taurus: Comfort is not the same as safety. The distinction matters today. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Gemini: The two things you want are not incompatible. You've been treating them as if they were. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Cancer: The person you've been nurturing needs you to need them back. Allow it. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Leo: Your creativity needs an outlet or it will find one you didn't choose. Give it space. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Virgo: You've been useful. You've been reliable. Today something needs you to be present rather than productive. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Libra: You've been maintaining a relationship through effort rather than desire. Worth examining why. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Scorpio: You are in a period of accumulating rather than expending. What you're gathering will matter. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Sagittarius: You are more certain than the situation warrants. A little less certainty opens more options. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Capricorn: You've been making decisions for the future at the expense of the present. Find the balance. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Aquarius: You are loyal to your ideas in the way others are loyal to people. Someone needs you to be loyal to them instead. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Pisces: Someone's pain has become your pain. This is your nature. Also: you are allowed to put it down. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
